Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ORlgyZFlTSFIy:
Before having my last wisdom tooth extracted (a prone tooth with a crooked root), I was so afraid of the pain that I endured it for almost twenty years. It grew to the size of my little fingertip 🥹 – huge! The root started causing pain in my cheek, and food particles constantly got stuck, forcing me to carry floss in my bag. Finally, while traveling abroad, I consulted a colleague about where to get it done. They recommended this clinic, saying it was minimally painful and healed quickly. I was skeptical, but I went anyway. They X-rayed the root and overall condition; it was prone to overlapping and the root was crooked.

The doctor was incredibly skilled and quite young. He decided to grind the tooth into pieces and then carefully extracted it with forceps, instead of prying, to avoid further gum trauma and pain. The hole in my gum was exactly the same size as the tooth that was ground away, with a smooth, clean edge. It didn't look bruised or infected like I'd seen in Google posts. The sutures were neatly hidden and perfectly aligned with my jawline. Even after I could open my mouth, the scar looked incredibly well-made.

I was so scared during the surgery, I almost had a meltdown. But after the procedure and the anesthetic wore off, there was a lot of pain for only about half an hour. Applying ice to my cheek quickly relieved the pain, and then there was no more pain at all. There was just a slight tightness from the stitches. Touching the wound with my tongue only caused a little ache. It didn't hurt at all; it was completely indifferent unless touched, which surprised me. This was a real wisdom tooth extraction! The only thing to watch out for is food particles getting into the tooth cavity. You have to either remove them or, like I did, use a children's syringe to inject saline into the cavity, and the food particles come out. It was so much fun! 🤣🥹 The wound healed quickly, in less than two weeks.

The extraction was also very easy, just a smooth, slippery motion. I had eight more teeth filled right away. The dentist said these fillings would last almost two more years.

I give this place a perfect ten out of ten. It was amazing!
